title: Practice 5: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: The pedestrian is crossing the road.
exercises.why: **переходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of переходить: imperfective (perfective partner: перейти).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).
**отвезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: Did you bring an umbrella with you?
exercises.why: **принёс** — past tense (masculine) of принести: perfective (imperfective partner: приносить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**прошёл** — past tense (masculine) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).
**отошёл** — past tense (masculine) of отойти: perfective (imperfective partner: отходить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
**довела** — past tense (feminine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

**выходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of выходить: imperfective (perfective partner: выйти).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: He came running to the meeting.
exercises.why: **прибежал** — past tense (masculine) of прибежать: perfective (imperfective partner: прибегать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The plane still hasn't taken off.
exercises.why: **взлетел** — past tense (masculine) of взлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: взлетать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: A sigh fell from her lips.
exercises.why: **слетел** — past tense (masculine) of слететь: perfective (imperfective partner: слетать).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
**отвозил** — past tense (masculine) of отвозить: imperfective (perfective partner: отвезти).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

**прошли** — past tense (plural) of пройти: perfective (imperfective partner: проходить).  Prefix **про-**: movement across, through, or past something (сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition).

**уезжаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of уезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: уехать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**довели** — past tense (plural) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: She is going to drive me crazy!
exercises.why: **сведёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of свести: perfective (imperfective partner: сводить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
**сводит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of сводить: imperfective (perfective partner: свести).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
**увезли** — past tense (plural) of увезти: perfective (imperfective partner: увозить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

**занесло** — past tense (neuter) of занести: perfective (imperfective partner: заносить).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

**пришёл** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
